lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular nodes arranged in a semi-regular grid between the pectoral fin and the second dorsal fin. The highest intensity maxima are concentrated along the second and third longitudinal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a rectangular grid of anchor nodes, most distinct in the central lateral field.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal side) to dark (ventral side) across the ridge apex.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a near-zero spot density on its distal two-thirds, with 3-5 low-contrast, high-luminance clusters limited to the posterior basal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or irregular indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. Faint linear depigmentation marks are visible on the mid-flank, posterior to the branchial slits.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher frequency and density of small-diameter, high-luminance spots relative to the mean spot size and density on the primary lateral flank.
